newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BEER PRODUCTION ROSE IN FIRST QUARTER.
newsitem.headline: BEER PRODUCTION ROSE IN FIRST QUARTER.

text.p: Lithuania's Breweries Association said on Friday that the output of the main breweries rose considerably in the first quarter and in March.

Jonas Martishauskas, spokesman for the association of the 10 biggest breweries, said the major breweries produced a total 2.35 million decalitres of beer in the first quarter of 1997 versus two million decalitres in the same period last year.
He said the output of market-leader Utenos was 238,000 decalitres in March, 18 percent up versus February.
He also said Kalnapilis produced 200,000 decalitres of beer last month, also an 18 percent rise.
Martishauskas said that the quaterly figures represented 95 percent of local beer production market.
